condition: Writing a UInt64/UInt32 column whose values cross 2^63/2^31 into a column chunk with several pages produces row-group statistics with min > max, so scan_parquet predicate pushdown drops rows that match.
workaround: Disable statistics when writing (statistics=False), or keep one page per chunk (the default data_page_size). When reading, you can also use read_parquet followed by filter, which skips pruning.
